title: Convexity question for the bounding function of normalized asymptotic translation length
statement:
Let $M$, $\mathcal{F}$, $d$, and $\Omega$ be as in the closure theorem: $M$ is a connected cusped hyperbolic $3$-manifold, $\mathcal{F}$ is a fully-punctured fibered face, and $\Omega$ is a rational $d$-dimensional slice with $d\geq 1$. Let $g\colon \operatorname{int}(\Omega)\to\mathbb{R}_+$ be the continuous function whose graph describes the accumulation points of the graph of the normalized asymptotic translation length function $\mu_d$.

**Convexity question.** Is the function $g$ convex?

The function $g$ is the boundary-diverging function controlling the accumulation behavior of $\mu_d$; its convexity is not clear from the explicit formula. This is posed as an open question.
references:
**10 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2008–2018). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:1608.02440](https://arxiv.org/abs/1608.02440), [arXiv:1606.05520](https://arxiv.org/abs/1606.05520), [arXiv:1512.02364](https://arxiv.org/abs/1512.02364), [arXiv:1511.01298](https://arxiv.org/abs/1511.01298), [arXiv:1511.00291](https://arxiv.org/abs/1511.00291), [arXiv:1511.05673](https://arxiv.org/abs/1511.05673), [arXiv:1109.3652](https://arxiv.org/abs/1109.3652), [arXiv:1005.5495](https://arxiv.org/abs/1005.5495), [arXiv:0811.1108](https://arxiv.org/abs/0811.1108).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.07236

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2018).
source_name: Balázs Strenner, “Fibrations of 3-manifolds and asymptotic translation length in the arc complex”, arXiv:1810.07236 (2020).
